collection.title: Weekly Meals
collection.promotionalMessage: Two breakfasts, two lunches, two dinners, and two snacks—ready to add to your shopping trip.

recipes.title: Protein Overnight Oats
recipes.shortDescription: Creamy overnight oats with Greek yogurt, berries, and protein powder for an easy make-ahead breakfast.

instructions.text: Add the oats, milk, Greek yogurt, protein powder, chia seeds, and salt to a jar or container.
Stir until no dry protein-powder pockets remain.
Fold in or top with the berries.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Add maple syrup when serving if desired.

substitutions.note: Supports a gluten-free option only when all packaged ingredients are verified.

recipes.title: Honey Garlic Chicken and Rice
recipes.shortDescription: Tender chicken and broccoli with a familiar honey-garlic sauce served over rice.

ingredients.rawText: Salt and black pepper to taste
ingredients.name: Salt and black pepper

instructions.text: Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces and season it with salt and pepper.
Cook the chicken in oil until browned and fully cooked.
Steam or sauté the broccoli.
Stir together the honey, soy sauce, garlic, and rice vinegar.
Add the sauce to the chicken.
Mix the cornstarch and water, then stir it into the sauce.
Simmer until the sauce thickens.
Serve with the rice and broccoli.

substitutions.note: Supports a gluten-free option when verified tamari is used.

metadata.accessibilityDescription: Honey garlic chicken with broccoli and rice.

recipes.title: One-Pot Cheeseburger Pasta
recipes.shortDescription: A family-style ground-beef pasta with cheddar, tomato, mustard, and classic cheeseburger flavors.

ingredients.rawText: Salt and black pepper to taste
ingredients.name: Salt and black pepper

instructions.text: Brown the ground beef with the onion.
Drain excess fat if needed.
Stir in the tomato paste, mustard, smoked paprika, and garlic powder.
Add the broth, milk, and pasta.
Bring to a gentle simmer, cover, and cook until the pasta is tender.
Stir periodically and add a small amount of water if the pan becomes dry.
Remove from the heat and stir in the cheddar cheese.
Season to taste.

recipes.title: Protein Berry Smoothie
recipes.shortDescription: A cold berry smoothie with banana, Greek yogurt, milk, and vanilla protein.

instructions.text: Add the milk, Greek yogurt, berries, banana, protein powder, and ice to a blender.
Blend until smooth.
Add water a small amount at a time if a thinner texture is desired.
Serve immediately.

substitutions.note: Use with a verified dairy-free yogurt and protein powder to support a dairy-free option.
Use with verified dairy-free milk and protein powder to support a dairy-free option.

recipes.title: Creamy Buffalo Chicken Dip
recipes.shortDescription: A creamy baked Buffalo chicken dip with shredded chicken, cheese, Greek yogurt, and hot sauce.

instructions.text: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Mix the chicken, cream cheese, Greek yogurt, hot sauce, half of the cheddar, and ranch seasoning.
Spread the mixture into a small baking dish.
Top with the remaining cheddar.
Bake until hot and bubbling.
Top with green onions if desired.

recipes.title: Make-Ahead Breakfast Burritos
recipes.shortDescription: Freezer-friendly breakfast burritos filled with eggs, sausage, potatoes, peppers, cheese, and salsa.

ingredients.rawText: 2 cups diced cooked potatoes or frozen hash browns
ingredients.name: Cooked potatoes or frozen hash browns

ingredients.rawText: Salt and black pepper to taste
ingredients.name: Salt and black pepper

instructions.text: Cook the sausage until browned, then transfer it to a plate.
Cook the potatoes, bell pepper, and onion until tender.
Scramble the eggs with salt and pepper.
Divide the sausage, vegetables, eggs, cheese, and salsa among the tortillas.
Fold into burritos.
Serve immediately or cool completely before wrapping and freezing.
Reheat until the center reaches a safe serving temperature.

recipes.title: Chicken Taco Rice Bowls
recipes.shortDescription: Seasoned chicken, rice, black beans, corn, vegetables, salsa, and cheese in a simple meal-prep bowl.

ingredients.rawText: 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed
ingredients.name: Black beans

ingredients.rawText: 1/2 cup shredded cheddar or Monterey Jack cheese
ingredients.name: Cheddar or Monterey Jack cheese

instructions.text: Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces and season it with taco seasoning.
Cook the chicken in oil until browned and fully cooked.
Add the bell pepper and onion and cook until tender-crisp.
Warm the rice, black beans, and corn.
Divide the rice among four bowls.
Add the chicken, vegetables, beans, corn, salsa, and cheese.
Finish with lime juice.

substitutions.note: Supports a gluten-free option only when seasoning and all packaged ingredients are verified.

recipes.title: Korean Ground Beef Bowls
recipes.shortDescription: Savory-sweet ground beef with rice, broccoli, garlic, ginger, and green onions.

instructions.text: Brown the ground beef and drain excess fat if needed.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook briefly.
Stir together the soy sauce, brown sugar or honey, and sesame oil.
Add the sauce to the beef and simmer until glossy.
Steam or sauté the broccoli until tender.
Divide the rice among four bowls.
Top with beef, broccoli, green onions, and optional sesame seeds.

substitutions.note: Supports a gluten-free option when verified tamari is used.
